newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African April business confidence index rises.
newsitem.headline: S.African April business confidence index rises.

text.p: The South African Chamber of Business said its business confidence index (1990 = 100) rose by 0.3 percentage points to 114.0 points in April from 113.7 points the previous month and 117.3 a year ago.

Positive influences on the index included the improvement in the consumer price index, and a rise in seasonally adjusted retail sales and merchandise exports. Negative influences included an increase in the number of insolvencies, a lower gold price and the lower merchandise import figure.
The index is a composite index which tracks the performance of 13 key economic indicators which have the greatest bearing on the business mood.
